task.title: Report accepted file-structure target gaps
task.summary: Make file-structure audit report missing accepted target paths unless implementation evidence, roadmap coverage, or deferral exists.

goal.outcome: Accepted target source paths and roots-to-retire produce actionable findings when they lack implementation evidence, active roadmap/sprint coverage, or structured deferral.
acceptance: File-structure audit distinguishes accepted target gaps, roots-to-retire, approved migration deltas, implemented paths, roadmap coverage, and structured deferrals.
Accepted target gaps without implementation evidence, active task/sprint coverage, or deferral become actionable findings instead of info-only entries.
Findings identify missing roots named by the accepted decision when still absent, including src/planning, src/implementation, src/graph, src/git, and src/pi.
Graph/status may project findings, but KB/roadmap/planning trace remain canonical truth.
TASK-specific tests cover absent accepted_target finding, covered path suppression, deferral evidence, and no false pass for info-only deltas.
non_goals: Do not move source files into missing target roots.
Do not implement roadmap auto-reuse policy.
Do not treat generated graph as canonical file-structure truth.
